    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    T = int(input[0])
    results = []
    index = 1
    for _ in range(T):
        P = input[index]
        days = 0
        i = 1
        while i < len(P):
            if P[i] == '.':
                gap_start = i
                while i < len(P) and P[i] == '.':
                    i += 1
                gap_length = i - gap_start
                if gap_length > days:
                    days = gap_length
            else:
                i += 1
        results.append(str(days))
        index += 1
    print('\n'.join(results))

main()
